faqs.question: What are signs of termites in Maspeth homes?
faqs.answer: Common signs include hollow-sounding wood, discarded wings near windowsills, mud tubes along foundations or basement walls, visible wood damage or frass (termite droppings), and sagging floors or ceilings. Maspeth's older homes are particularly susceptible, so annual inspections are recommended. If you notice any of these signs, contact us immediately for a free phone assessment to discuss the damage.

faqs.question: How long does termite treatment take in Maspeth?
faqs.answer: Most termite treatments in Maspeth are completed in 1–2 days depending on the method used and property size. Liquid barrier treatments typically take 4–8 hours, while bait station installations are quicker but require ongoing monitoring over several months. Fumigation treatments for drywood termites may require 2–3 days including preparation and aeration time. We'll provide a specific timeline during your free phone assessment.
